answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny thus loses 95 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the river decay curve is applied at close, the delta weight of every idle key falls, and the beacon history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 77% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 23 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
